sections.title: Improvements
items: Slot Machine now runs configured inventory maintenance and Team Stone Heal/Repair before its first Challenge.
Slot Machine performs a one-time configured maintenance pass after the controlled character successfully leaves the party due to insufficient VP.

sections.title: Bug Fixes
items: Updated Tailed Beast post-maintenance status handling to avoid leaving Start disabled because of stale UI state.
Improved Valhalla Combat Results detection and closure to reduce stalls between dungeon fights.
Improved Valhalla dungeon map selection by matching the requested level instead of relying on a fixed list position.
Outdoor Exploration Scan Map now supports Stop during refresh and bounds panel-opening retries.
Outdoor Exploration refresh status is reconciled after cancellation and duplicate refresh requests are rejected.
